welcome_lead: Families come in all shapes — meet the types. 👨‍👩‍👧
meta_desc: Family & Identity Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on different types of family in the UK.
final_note: You met the main family types and learned how family life is changing.

concepts.def: Group of people related or living closely

walkthroughs.body_html:
UK families take many forms:

  • Nuclear — two parents + kids.
  • Single-parent — one adult + kids.
  • Extended — adds grandparents, cousins.
  • Step-family, same-sex, foster.

Family functions include:

  • Care for children.
  • Teach values.
  • Provide love and identity.
  • Support in tough times.

UK family life has changed:

  • More divorce → more single-parent and step-families.
  • Same-sex marriage legal in 2014.
  • People marry later or not at all.

Family life keeps adapting. 💛
